DIAGNOSIS READY: Acute Myeloid Leukemia

The peripheral smear confirms the presence of abnormal, immature cells with characteristic "Auer rods" (pink, needle-shaped inclusions), which are pathognomonic for Acute Myeloid Leukemia. Given your age and the rapid progression of pancytopenia with leukocytosis, this is an urgent diagnosis requiring immediate admission for chemotherapy.
